title: Aromatic Spicy Canadian Napa Cabbage Stir Fry
description: This spicy Canadian dish features napa cabbage and is pescatarian-friendly, perfect for a monsoon evening, with a shattering blend of flavors and textures, whisked to perfection.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the salmon and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the shredded napa cabbage and stir-fry until wilted.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, sriracha sauce, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the sauce over the cabbage mixture and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced green onions if desired.
Use a whisk to toss the ingredients and ensure even coating with the sauce.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving platter and serve immediately.
